title: Community Health II (DPH2103): Main Exam, Thur. 17th July, 2025 11.00am
department: Department of Environmental Health and Health System Management / Community Health, Epidemiology and Biostatistics
programme: Diploma in Health Records and Information Technology
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO IN SECTION B.

items.text: Define the following terms as used in community health.
Name any three indicators used in assessing community health.
List four aims of primary health care.
Explain any three principles of managing communicable diseases.
Describe three principles of PHC according to Alma Ata Declaration-WHO 1978.
Elaborate any four elements of primary health care.
